nodes.name: HistoryEntry.kt
nodes.summary: Data class representing a browsing history entry with timestamp, URL, and title, with JSON serialization support.

nodes.name: HistoryEntry
nodes.summary: Data class holding timestamp, URL, and title for a single browsing history entry with a companion object for JSON deserialization.

nodes.name: toJSON
nodes.summary: Serializes the history entry to a JSONObject with timestamp, URL, and title fields.

nodes.name: HistoryFragment.kt
nodes.summary: Jetpack Compose fragment that displays the browsing history grouped by day with a clear action, using the HistoryManager for data persistence.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Jetpack Compose for UI rendering with Material3 components and LazyColumn for the grouped history list.

nodes.name: HistoryFragment
nodes.summary: Compose-based fragment that loads and displays browsing history grouped by day, with clear-all action and item selection returning URL results.

nodes.name: onCreate
nodes.summary: Initializes the HistoryManager instance during fragment creation.

nodes.name: onCreateView
nodes.summary: Inflates the fragment layout and returns the root view.

nodes.name: onViewCreated
nodes.summary: Sets up the Compose content with a top app bar and a clear history action button, then triggers history loading.

nodes.name: loadHistory
nodes.summary: Loads and displays the browsing history using Compose, rendering empty state text or a grouped LazyColumn with date headers and clickable entries.

nodes.name: groupByDay
nodes.summary: Groups history entries by calendar day using a Calendar instance, producing interspersed header and entry items for list display.

nodes.name: clearHistory
nodes.summary: Clears all browsing history via the HistoryManager and reloads the empty state.

nodes.name: HistoryItem.kt
nodes.summary: Defines a sealed interface and two implementation classes representing history list items: day headers and individual entry items.

nodes.name: HistoryItem
nodes.summary: Sealed interface as the base type for history list items, allowing either date headers or entry items.

nodes.name: HistoryHeaderItem
nodes.summary: Data class representing a day header in the grouped history list, holding the header text string.

nodes.name: HistoryEntryItem
nodes.summary: Data class wrapping a HistoryEntry for rendering as a clickable row in the history list.

nodes.name: HistoryManager.kt
nodes.summary: Manages browsing history persistence to a JSON file, providing add, load, save, and clear operations with deduplication.

nodes.name: HistoryManager
nodes.summary: Manages a list of HistoryEntry objects with JSON file persistence, supporting add with deduplication, clear, load, and save operations.

nodes.name: addEntry
nodes.summary: Adds a URL and title to the history list with deduplication against the most recent entry, then persists to file.

nodes.name: clearHistory
nodes.summary: Deletes the history file from storage and logs the action.

nodes.name: loadHistory
nodes.summary: Loads the history from a JSON file, parsing each entry using HistoryEntry.fromJSON.

nodes.name: saveHistory
nodes.summary: Serializes the history list to JSON and writes it to the history file with error handling.

nodes.name: MainActivity.kt
nodes.summary: Main browser activity providing navigation controls, URL bar, media session notification handling, and integration with history and settings management.

nodes.name: MainActivity
nodes.summary: Main browser activity that manages the Servo web view, bottom navigation bar, URL field, media session playback, and history recording.

nodes.name: bindClick
nodes.summary: Binds a click listener to a view identified by its resource ID, dispatching actions to the dispatchAction handler.

nodes.name: onCreate
nodes.summary: Initializes the activity: sets up the Servo view, bottom navigation, URL field, history manager, media session, and applies any launch intent URL.

nodes.name: onDestroy
nodes.summary: Hides media session controls when the activity is destroyed.

nodes.name: dispatchAction
nodes.summary: Dispatches bottom navigation actions: back, forward, reload, stop, and opens Settings or History activities via intents.

nodes.name: setupUrlField
nodes.summary: Configures the URL input field with an editor action listener for loading URLs and focus change listeners for keyboard management.

nodes.name: loadUrlFromField
nodes.summary: Loads the URL currently entered in the URL field into the Servo view.

nodes.name: onImeShow
nodes.summary: Shows the soft input keyboard for URL entry.

nodes.name: onImeHide
nodes.summary: Hides the soft input keyboard.

nodes.name: onKeyDown
nodes.summary: Handles key down events for the activity.

nodes.name: onKeyUp
nodes.summary: Handles key up events for the activity.

nodes.name: onAlert
nodes.summary: Displays an Android AlertDialog with the given message from web content.

nodes.name: onLoadStarted
nodes.summary: Updates UI when page load begins: disables back/forward buttons and shows loading progress indicator.

nodes.name: onLoadEnded
nodes.summary: Updates UI when page load ends: adds a history entry, hides progress, and enables navigation buttons.

nodes.name: onTitleChanged
nodes.summary: Stores the current page title when the title changes.

nodes.name: onUrlChanged
nodes.summary: Updates the URL field text and current URL when the page URL changes.

nodes.name: onHistoryChanged
nodes.summary: Enables or disables the back/forward navigation buttons based on current navigation history state.

nodes.name: onRedrawing
nodes.summary: Shows or hides the idle/loading text indicator based on redrawing state.

nodes.name: onPause
nodes.summary: Pauses both the Servo view and the activity lifecycle.

nodes.name: onResume
nodes.summary: Resumes both the activity and Servo view, and updates settings if necessary.

nodes.name: onBackPressed
nodes.summary: Navigates back in the Servo view history if available, otherwise delegates to the default back behavior.

nodes.name: onActivityResult
nodes.summary: Handles results from child activities: loads a URL returned from the history activity.

nodes.name: onMediaSessionMetadata
nodes.summary: Updates the media session notification with title, artist, and album metadata from web content.

nodes.name: onMediaSessionPlaybackStateChange
nodes.summary: Shows or hides the media session notification controls based on the playback state, including paused vs playing differentiation.

nodes.name: onMediaSessionSetPositionState
nodes.summary: Logs the media playback position state when position updates occur.

nodes.name: onAnimatingIndicatorPrefChanged
nodes.summary: Toggles the animating loading indicator preference on the Servo view.

nodes.name: onExperimentalPrefChanged
nodes.summary: Toggles the experimental mode setting on the Servo view.

nodes.name: updateSettingsIfNecessary
nodes.summary: Loads shared preferences and applies animating indicator and experimental mode settings to the Servo view.

nodes.name: MediaSession.kt
nodes.summary: Manages Android media notification for web audio and video playback with play/pause/next/prev controls.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Android NotificationCompat.MediaStyle with dynamic broadcast receivers for media button actions.

nodes.name: MediaSession
nodes.summary: Manages Android media notification display with play/pause/next/previous actions, notification channel, and dynamic broadcast receiver registration.

nodes.name: createMediaNotificationChannel
nodes.summary: Creates the Android notification channel for media playback notifications.

nodes.name: showMediaSessionControls
nodes.summary: Displays a media notification with play/pause, next, and previous actions, registering a broadcast receiver for button interactions.

nodes.name: hideMediaSessionControls
nodes.summary: Cancels the media notification and unregisters the broadcast receiver.

nodes.name: setPlaybackState
nodes.summary: Updates the stored playback state value.

nodes.name: updateMetadata
nodes.summary: Updates media metadata (title, artist, album) and refreshes the media notification controls.

nodes.name: SettingsActivity.kt
nodes.summary: Activity that hosts the SettingsFragment for configuring browser preferences.

nodes.name: SettingsActivity
nodes.summary: Activity that displays the SettingsFragment for modifying browser preferences.

nodes.name: onCreate
nodes.summary: Sets up the activity layout and replaces the container with a SettingsFragment instance.

nodes.name: SettingsFragment.kt
nodes.summary: Fragment providing UI toggles for animating loading indicator and experimental mode preferences, with persistence via SharedPreferences.

nodes.name: SettingsFragment
nodes.summary: Fragment with switches for animating indicator and experimental mode, loading current preferences and saving changes.

nodes.name: onCreate
nodes.summary: Initializes the default shared preferences instance.

nodes.name: onCreateView
nodes.summary: Inflates the settings layout.

nodes.name: onViewCreated
nodes.summary: Binds UI elements: close button, animating indicator switch, and experimental mode switch, with click and checked-change listeners for saving preferences.

nodes.name: loadPreferences
nodes.summary: Reads current preference values from SharedPreferences and sets the UI switches accordingly.

nodes.name: savePreference
nodes.summary: Saves a boolean preference key-value pair to SharedPreferences.

nodes.name: bottom_menu_colors.xml
nodes.summary: Android color selector resource defining the bottom navigation menu item colors for enabled, selected, and default states.

nodes.name: cancel.webp
nodes.summary: WebP image asset for the cancel/close button icon used in the browser UI.

nodes.name: history_back.webp
nodes.summary: WebP image asset for the history back navigation icon.

nodes.name: history_forward.webp
nodes.summary: WebP image asset for the history forward navigation icon.
